title: Local pure-tensor normalization of the actual coefficient section encoding
statement: Let A be a commutative topological ring, R a commutative condensed ring, e : R ≅ coefficient(A) a ring-object isomorphism, T a scheme, and c : realizationRing(T, ULift A) ≅ sectionRing(A,T) any ring-sheaf isomorphism. Suppose the induced inverse coefficient map on T is invertible. Let F be the actual composite Mod.comap(coefficientMap(e⁻¹,T)) followed by sectionEncoding(A,T,c) and fixedRestriction(A,T). There exists a strong monoidal structure on F for the native relative and fixed-scalar sheaf tensors whose forward tensorator takes every local fixed-scalar pure tensor x ⊗ y to the internal balanced pure tensor of those same two additive sections. No finiteness, nonzero-ring or scheme nonemptiness assumption is made. The coefficient and section encodings are those of [def-sfb-finite-coefficient-operation-encoding], the internal pure pairing is from [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison], and the fixed pairing is from [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor].

proof.text: Use the internal/section comparison, including its local pure-tensor formula and all associator and unitor identities. Construct the monoidal structure with CoreMonoidal.mk' so its tensorator is definitionally the inverse of this particular comparison. Evaluate the inverse identity on a pure tensor to retain the inverse generator formula.

Compose with the normalized ring-isomorphism scalar restriction and the normalized constant-scalar restriction. Their tensorators take a local pure pair to that same pair. Restriction along the inverse condensed coefficient isomorphism also preserves the relative pairing, by the coequalizer projection formula for comapTensorIso. Thus the tensorator of the actual composite sends each local fixed-scalar pure tensor to the original internal pure tensor. The argument uses universal balanced pairings and is valid for the zero ring and the empty scheme.

theorem coefficientSectionTensor_normalized
    (e : Mon.mk R ≅ Mon.mk (coefficient A)) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : realizationRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ULift.{u + 1} A) ≅ sectionRing A T)
    [IsIso (coefficientMap e.inv.hom T)] :
    let F := Mod.comap (coefficientMap e.inv.hom T) ⋙
      (sectionEncoding A T c ⋙ fixedRestriction A T)
    ∃ m : F.Monoidal,
      ∀ (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj R T))
        (V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.X.obj.obj V) (y : N.X.obj.obj V),
        ((m.toLaxMonoidal.μ M N).hom.app V)
          (ConstantScalarRestriction.fixedPure (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ULift.{u + 1} A)
            (F.obj M) (F.obj N) V x y) =
          InternalAbelianSheafModule.comparison_internalTmul (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            (condensedRingObj R T) M N V x y
